Name: ACROSS_DAY_CORRECT_PARAM_ST
Description: Day scaling for SpEffects with bGameClearBonus set (NR's version of ER's NG+ correction). The row for the current day and correction type multiplies those SpEffects' values; a rate of 0 or less, or no matching row (outside an expedition), makes the game ignore the value. Retail: 0 on Day 1 and 1 on Days 2-3, so the [Day 2 Scaling] SpEffects take effect from Day 2.

Fields.Name: Correction Type
Fields.Description: Which of three correction sets this row belongs to (0-2). The game picks the set from the current session; one session type always uses 0, and outside expeditions no row applies. Retail: rows 10-12, 20-22 and 30-32 are types 0, 1 and 2.

Fields.Name: Day
Fields.Description: The expedition day this row applies to (1-3), taken from the day's progress flags. The first row for each type and day is used; row 0 is never used.

Fields.Name: Unknown
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail 0.

Fields.Name: Unknown
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail 0.
